image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is translucent grey plastic with visible internal components including two spools and the central hub mechanism. There is a paper label on the face with handwritten text in black ink. The image has a grainy, low-resolution aesthetic typical of older digital photography or film scans.

artifact_observations.location: Handwritten label on the cassette face
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the label mimics handwriting but lacks legible semantic content. Characters are malformed, connected incorrectly, or dissolve into scribbles, which is a common artifact in AI-generated images attempting to render text.
The plastic surface has an overly uniform, noisy grain that doesn't quite match the specular highlights expected from smooth injection-molded plastic. It looks slightly 'muddy' rather than sharp.

The mechanical details of the central tape path and hub connection are vague and lack the precise engineering geometry found in real cassettes. The shapes merge slightly rather than having crisp edges.
